short.title: Thinkers of Cernavodă: Seated Figurines 7,000 #Shorts
short.hook: Two 7,000-year-old clay figurines from Cernavodă, Romania, show a man and woman seated in meditative poses.
script: Two 7,000-year-old clay figurines from Cernavodă, Romania, show a man and woman seated in meditative poses.
The 'Thinker' bends forward, elbows on knees, head in hands — a pose linked to meditation and possibly astronomy.
The Seated Woman has a bent neck and prominent hips, suggesting symbolic, not realistic, representation.
Archaeologists believe these may represent masculine-feminine balance or mourners buried with the dead.
Some link the poses to early sun worship, like the Nebra sky disc, though evidence is indirect.
The figurines were made by the Hamangia people, who lived from 5200 to 4500 B.C. and built hilltop settlements.
Sun worship, gender balance, or mourning?
Tap the link below for the full case file.
short.description:
The Thinkers of Cernavodă are 7,000-year-old clay figurines from a Stone Age cemetery in Romania. They depict a seated man and woman in stylized, meditative poses, possibly linked to astronomical or spiritual beliefs. Some researchers suggest they represent complementary genders or mourners, while others connect them to early solar worship. The Hamangia culture, active from 5200 to 4500 B.C., focused on herding and built defensive hilltop settlements. Source: Live Science, https://www.livescience.com/archaeology/thinkers-of-cernavoda-mysterious-stone-age-figurines-discovered-in-a-7-000-year-old-grave-in-romania
